claim_ceiling: The exact Claude desktop-app and embedded-engine versions completed one user-assisted session in a sanitized unregistered Git fixture where no Engram MCP server or memory tool was exposed. This establishes only the observed host-surface-unavailable result; it does not prove that the managed wrapper started or refused the unregistered remote.
limitations: Normal Claude desktop logging retained the selected fixture, exact embedded-engine path and version, and clean application shutdown, but not the local Engram wrapper's startup or exit reason.
The unavailable tool surface may be consistent with fail-closed unregistered-project behavior, but wrapper invocation and resolver refusal were not independently observed.
No Engram memory or provider tool was called, and no memory content was read or saved.
The exact tool-call execution timestamp was not retained; recorded_at is the later evidence-capture time on the same date.
This diagnostic observation does not satisfy the unregistered-project acceptance case and does not promote Claude host support.
